comparison.objective: Swipe a magnetic-stripe card through a reader once and return it to its stand.
comparison.physical_skill: Orient, constrain, and translate a thin card through a slot at bounded speed without reversal.
comparison.success_condition: One valid full-span read at rated speed, card returned and released; drops or failed/extra swipes reduce or eliminate credit.
comparison.reason: Controlled slot traversal and card handling do not exercise mechanical adjustment, fastener locking, or closed-loop impact commissioning.
